reference.policy: Reference speed only; authored steering and mesh, no imported renderer or projectile class

appearance.cameraPolicy: 2026-10-09 shared revision: preserve authored material alpha; no first-person proximity or crosshair auto fading/clipping

preview.label: 离线移动靶；飞行演示不是游戏命中验证
preview.launchPolicy: Original server pulse ticks 0/12/24. Editable bolt bones remain the source of the three muzzle positions; held bolts are hidden after release and real entities own flight.

runtimePolicy.targetSelection: Existing valid hostile target inside range and cone; never self, allied, spectator or dead targets
runtimePolicy.collision: Swept collision per substep; resolve nearest block/entity intersection before movement, never endpoint-only
runtimePolicy.lossPolicy: Keep last heading; continue at current speed, then expire at range/lifetime limit
runtimePolicy.clientPolicy: Orient authored seed to authoritative velocity; history trail only, no cosmetic path used as damage authority
